name: thesis_grid_methods
description: Thesis result 1, the grid-method comparison (docs/experiments/thesis/grid-methods.md): the same market, participants, days and learning under four ways the grid reaches the fees. no_fees: fees recorded, not paid (the reference). powerflow: line loading and voltage drop measured in the AC power flow (the scenario's own settings), and the measured losses shared by branch currents (dso.losses bcdla) in place of eq. 18. graph: [P1]'s graph model, capacity split by inverse line length, voltage drop f_volt * d_ij (eq. 8f). graph_ratings: the graph model with each line's rating. The power flow is recorded in every arm, so the physical outcome is compared on the same footing. OPEN before the final run: the graph model's total capacity and f_volt, the fee thresholds with the grid stress; the transformer in the fees; a stress setting for the line ratings (both not built yet); paradigm, budget and seeds after the RL stage.
